dedupe_keys.name: cotality formerly corelogic property records climate and hazard risk data

description: Cotality, the company formerly called CoreLogic (corelogic.com now redirects to cotality.com), sells property, climate and hazard risk and market data mainly to mortgage, insurance, real estate, telecom and public sector users. Coverage: 5.5 billion US property records spanning 50 years with a stated 99.9 percent market coverage, about 1 million new Australian property data points a month, and 2.2 billion records on the energy efficiency of UK properties; the company cites more than 98 percent property coverage in its largest markets, 30 years of history and 30-year forecasts of environmental risk from hundreds of analytical models covering property identification, enriched records, hazard risk and energy modelling; its Hazard HQ pages track catastrophe events by peril (earthquake, extratropical and tropical cyclone, flood, severe weather, wildfire, winter storm) with estimates of exposed homes, reconstruction cost value and insured losses. Format and access: the Araya SaaS platform, custom APIs, bulk file exports, data marketplaces on Databricks, Google Cloud and Snowflake, and an MCP server for AI agents; commercial. Licence: commercial terms, not read. Caveats: the pages read are marketing summaries, so the fields and resolution of each dataset and model were not checked; prices are not published; figures are the vendor's. Simulation uses: building-level exposure, replacement cost and hazard scores for hazard exposure and loss models of housing and infrastructure, and event loss estimates for emergency response studies. Related records: LightBox US parcel and building data (data-lightbox-smartfabric-parcels-buildings-us) and Nearmap aerial imagery and property AI (data-nearmap-aerial-imagery-and-ai-layers).
